_doc: ElevenLabs で作る効果音の一覧。node tools/sfx/generate.mjs で public/assets/sfx/ に書き出し、manifest.json を更新する。方針は docs/sfx-enemy-hit.md

hurt_light.use: 敵の通常攻撃が自分に当たった（のけぞり・ひるみ。ガードの上から削られたときも小さめに鳴らす）
hurt_light.prompt: Close-up game sound effect: a monster's claw strikes an adventurer wearing leather armor. One tight punchy body thud with a dry leather and cloth slap and a faint rattle of metal buckles. Sharp attack, very short decay, dry, no reverb tail, no voice, no grunt, no music.

hurt_heavy.use: 大技・最大HPの25%以上の被弾（吹き飛んでダウン）、這いずり状態になった瞬間
hurt_heavy.prompt: Brutal heavy impact game sound effect: a giant ogre's club slams into an armored warrior and knocks him down. Deep low-end boom with a crunchy armor clank on the hit and a short scatter of metal and gravel afterwards. Hard punchy transient, tail under one second, dry, no voice, no scream, no music.
